title: VTG Playboy Magazine October 1998 Complete With Centerfold - Cindy Crawford
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from October 1998, featuring a centerfold of Cindy Crawford. This edition includes illustrations and is written in English. With a monthly publication frequency, this magazine caters to a male audience interested in photography and modeling. It does not come with a subscription option, making it a collector's item for fans of classic Playboy magazine content.
